name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his university years. While studying marketing, a guest lecture by a Formula 1 team's head of communications ignited a passion he never knew he possessed. After graduation, Li dedicated himself to understanding the intricacies of the motorsport industry, starting with an internship at a local racing event. His keen eye for detail and ability to connect with audiences quickly propelled him through the ranks. 

At MP Motorsport, Li approaches his role with a data-driven mindset, always seeking innovative ways to boost brand visibility and engagement. He believes in crafting compelling narratives that resonate with fans, sponsors, and the team itself. What sets Li apart is his understanding of both Eastern and Western marketing strategies, allowing him to create campaigns that appeal to a global audience. 

Li's ambition isn't just about climbing the corporate ladder; it's about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in motorsport marketing. He is committed to ensuring that MP Motorsport remains at the forefront of the sport, both on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Li is of average height with a lean build, always impeccably dressed.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down marketing ideas, regardless of the situation.
Insists on having green tea before every important meeting.
Has a habit of pacing while on phone calls.
